entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The ruling council of spirits of the Orzhov Syndicate on Ravnica.

entities.name: Grandfather Karlov
entities.description: Head of the Obzedat, dead for centuries.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Grand Envoy of the Obzedat, later guildmaster; murdered, then her spirit assembled a new Ghost Council.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who killed the Obzedat and became guildmaster.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: In the Echoverse, a spirit dragon who bought a seat on the Ghost Council and bankrupted the Orzhov.

entities.name: Izmagnus
entities.description: Niv-Mizzet's hand-picked successor to run the Izzet.

events.summary: Kaya killed all members of the Council and took over as guildmaster, ending the Obzedat's reign.
events.quote: The reign of the Obzedat ended when the planeswalker Kaya killed all members of the Council and took over as guildmaster .

events.summary: After Teysa Karlov was murdered, her spirit assembled a new Ghost Council.
events.quote: After the reigning guildmaster Teysa Karlov was murdered, her spirit assembled a new Ghost Council.

events.summary: In the Echoverse, Niv-Mizzet died in battle against the nephilim.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet died in battle against the rampaging nephilim

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet bankrupted the Orzhov through life-insurance policies and bought himself a seat on the Ghost Council.
events.quote: he all but bankrupted the Orzhov Syndicate and bought himself a seat on the Ghost Council.
